coreLoop: Fight through an escalating horde in a short real-time survival run while positioning around enemy pressure.
Collect run rewards or experience and choose upgrades, perks, weapons, or skills that change the current build.
Combine upgrades into a stronger build, survive harder waves or a boss, then convert the run result into the next progression choice.

signatureSystems.name: Strategic Resource Management
signatureSystems.purpose: Resource gathering and management for upgrades and survival.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Gather resources and allocate them to upgrades, perks, weapons, or skills.

signatureSystems.name: Character Progression
signatureSystems.purpose: Develop the player character's abilities and stats.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Improve character attributes, unlock new skills, and enhance combat capabilities.

signatureSystems.name: Combat System
signatureSystems.purpose: Engaging in dynamic and challenging combat encounters.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Engage in combat, strategically utilize abilities, and adapt to enemy patterns.

signatureSystems.name: Narrative Storytelling
signatureSystems.purpose: Craft a compelling and immersive story experience.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Explore the world, uncover lore, and make choices that affect the narrative.

signatureSystems.name: Procedural Generation
signatureSystems.purpose: Generate diverse and challenging encounters and levels.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Adapt to the current environment and encounter, and choose the best path to survival.

technicalAssumptions: Player will have a limited number of lives.
Enemy AI will be relatively simple but challenging.
The game will feature a dynamic level design.
The game will have a focus on player choice and consequence.
